title: Initial velocity magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly calculate v₀ = 2 m/s from the horizontal component of v_A.

title: Projectile displacement calculation
description: Important Criteria: Student must compute both horizontal (≈0.69 m) and vertical (0.6 m) displacements from P to A using projectile equations.

title: Velocity at point C
description: Important Criteria: Student must apply energy conservation between A and C to find v_C = √7 m/s.

title: Post-C projectile analysis
description: Important Criteria: Student must set up equations for motion from C to A and compare required vs. possible horizontal travel.

title: Correct conclusion about hitting A
description: Essential Criteria: Student must conclude the ball cannot hit point A after flying from C.

title: Angle interpretation at A
description: Important Criteria: Student must recognize that the velocity at A is tangent to the circle, making 60° with horizontal.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All quantities should carry correct units throughout the solution.

title: Sign error in energy equation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if gravitational potential energy difference (A to C) has wrong sign in energy conservation.

title: Confusing horizontal components
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if student incorrectly assumes v₀ = v_A or misidentifies the horizontal component at A.
